question:
Which of the following letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

CMN101, KUV82, SCD63, AKL44, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11736a0e2f966f37152868aa21fb3c05aac7a2686375a096bd981c842f02388a.png] 

Given Series: CMN101, KUV82, SCD63, AKL44, ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496e20d9b6cfdc5447e385dc88610b0ce97d19e0c0635d816c0a05cc3acdbff0.png] 

 

The pattern observed for letters is: (Letter position + 8) and for numbers: (Number - 19).

Therefore, the next cluster in the series is IST25.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
